routes.name: Visa-free entry (EAC, SADC, most Commonwealth)
routes.summary: Citizens of EAC and SADC member states (except Comoros) and most Commonwealth countries don't need a visa. UK, Canada, Nigeria, India, Pakistan, Australia and New Zealand are excluded from the Commonwealth rule.

other: Official page doesn't give a full country list. Check the guidelines for your passport.

routes.name: Ordinary Visa (eVisa or on arrival)
routes.summary: Single-entry visa for tourism, meetings, visiting family or workshops. Up to 90 days. No work or business. Online is the recommended way to apply.

other: Passport valid 6+ months with one blank page
Each traveler needs their own application, including kids
US passport holders need the Multiple visa instead
Some nationalities (e.g. Nigeria, Pakistan, Iran, Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, Syria, Yemen) can't get a visa on arrival without special permission

routes.processing: About 10 days for online applications, per the guidelines.

routes.name: Multiple Entry Visa
routes.summary: Valid up to 1 year, with a max of 90 days per visit. US passport holders must use this one even for a single trip. Also used for non-resident directors, government consultancy and family visits.

other: Category documents needed, e.g. company letter and BRELA search for non-resident directors, or invitation letter and marriage or birth certificate for family visits

stay.note: Up to 90 days per visit, valid up to 1 year.

routes.name: Business Visa
routes.summary: Single-entry visa for short work assignments of up to 3 months. For longer stays you need a work or residence permit.

other: Work contract or proof of assignment of no more than 3 months

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: For passing through Tanzania to another country. Max 7 days.

other: Entry visa for the next country and/or an onward ticket

routes.name: Student Visa
routes.summary: Short study visa. Fee depends on how long the program is. Language courses max 6 months.

other: Cover letter from the host institution with course and duration
The guidelines list inconsistent student fees, so check with immigration

routes.name: Residence Permit Class A (self-employed and investors)
routes.summary: For shareholders and directors of a registered company. Capital must meet the Investment Act minimum. Joining an existing company needs 100,000 USD capital (half for EAC citizens).

investment.note: When joining an existing company. Half for EAC citizens. New companies follow Investment Act minimums.

other: Page doesn't state how long a permit lasts

routes.name: Residence Permit Class B (employment)
routes.summary: For expats with skills not readily available locally who have a job offer from a specific employer. Apply before entering Tanzania.

other: Page doesn't state how long a permit lasts

routes.name: Residence Permit Class C (retirees, researchers, volunteers, others)
routes.summary: Catch-all permit for people who don't fit A or B. Includes researchers, retirees 55+, missionaries, volunteers, NGO staff, interns and buyers of real estate. Retirees can apply after arriving.

other: Age 55+ applies to the retiree category (C-2) only
Most categories must apply before entry
